## Goal

What should this tool help contributors verify or document?

## Inputs

## Outputs

## Legal Boundary

Explain how the tool avoids redistributing ISO contents, binaries, extracted assets, or proprietary data.

## Validation

How should the tool be tested with synthetic fixtures or metadata-only samples?

## Open Questions

List assumptions or unknowns.
